mechanism: ACE inhibitors potentiate the anticoagulant effect of low-molecular-weight heparins through inhibition of angiotensin II-mediated platelet aggregation and increased bradykinin levels, elevating bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for signs of bleeding (bruising, hematuria, hemoptysis); renal function should be assessed regularly as both drugs affect renal perfusion; dose adjustments may be necessary in renal impairment.
